summary: I could not refute any identity fact. Re-read live on 2026-11-15, these all match the record: the repo is official under the verified mistralai org, created 2025-11-28 and announced 2025-12-09; it is Apache-2.0; it has 24.01B params (BF16 + F8_E4M3); config values (40 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, sliding_window null, YaRN factor 48, max_pos 393216); a 256K stated context; image + text input; no thinking mode; [AVAILABLE_TOOLS]/[TOOL_CALLS] tool calling; the commit history; the vendor benchmarks 68.0/55.7/22.5; the independent SWE-bench mini-SWE-agent 1.17.2 score of 56.4; the llama.cpp issues and PR; and the Ollama manifest and badges. Two corrections. (1) The current chat template does NOT allow 'system or user after any role': a system message after assistant or tool raises an exception, and a tool message may only follow assistant or tool. OpenCode clients that insert mid-conversation system messages after tool results would still fail. (2) The repo is not actually gated (API gated=false); the card only carries an extra_gated_description privacy note. I could not confirm the AA Terminal-Bench 2.1 (29.6%), Terminal-Bench Hard (16.7%) and TB 4.0 numbers in the raw page JSON: no terminal-bench keys appeared near the Devstral Small 2 block. Only tau2 0.2339 and LiveCodeBench 0.3481 were found there, and that same block also names Qwen3.8 27B, so the attribution risk stays. Scope: identity and capability facts only. I did not re-check the vLLM and llama.cpp memory arithmetic, the checkpoint sizes or the vLLM issue list.

Modalities: text + image in, text out; Ollama shows 'Text, Image', badges vision and tools, no thinking badge; 2.8M downloads, updated 11 months ago; manifest model blob 15,177,370,240 B, params blob 21 B
No thinking mode; chat template has no THINK handling

Tool calling: template lines 36-41 build [AVAILABLE_TOOLS]tools|tojson[/AVAILABLE_TOOLS] (emitted before the first user turn), line 182 emits [TOOL_CALLS] then name[ARGS]args; card says 'Devstral Small 2 supports tool calling'
Current template merges consecutive same-role messages and allows system or user after any role
verdicts.correction: The merge logic exists (lines ~71-102), but role-order checks (lines 122-143) only allow: after system -> user/assistant/system; after user -> assistant/system/user; after assistant -> assistant/user/tool (NOT system); after tool -> assistant/tool/user (NOT system). A system message after an assistant or tool turn raises 'Unexpected role'. The conversation must also start with user or system.

verdicts.correction: The leaderboard file lists the row under 'Verified' with agent mini-SWE-agent (a bash-only agent). It is not labeled 'bash-only' in the file.
Values 0.2339 and 0.3481 appear in the JSON block named 'Devstral Small 2' (slug devstral-small-2). That window also names Qwen3.8 27B, so attribution rests on proximity.

In the raw HTML fetched on 2026-11-15, no terminalbench-type key or matching value (0.296 / 0.167) appears near the Devstral Small 2 block. The only '16.7' strings are SVG path data. Treat these three numbers as unverified.
